_note: Form definitions (plan AD7). Every form hands off to site.form_recipient by mailto (partials/form.html, js/forms.js). Options marked options_from are built from that data file (in-range varieties, towns), never copied here; extra_options are added after them. label: the visible label; mail_label: the label in the mail body when it differs; error: the inline message when the field is empty or invalid. ui: the strings the form engine shows around every form. contact (S6): reasons select (R32) first, a mode per reason ("afhalen" for bestelling-thuis, R42) whose strings live under modes; fields with mode_only/mode_not/optional_in follow it in js/forms.js. grootkeuken (S13): the needs helper is the first fieldset (group_start/group_end, radios), its four answers are ordinary fields of the form, so they are in the mail body; no kilogram figure, price or formula (R20). Forms with an empty fields list are defined in their own slice: speciaalzaak S14, adoptie S16, interesse-buitenkweek S17.
